instruction: Pull over behind the white van directly ahead.
paraphrases: Stop behind the white van in front of us.|Follow the white van ahead and pull over behind it.

instruction: Pass the white car on the left, then stop near the dark sedan on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the left-hand white car and pull over by the dark sedan on the right.|After the white car on the left, stop beside the right-hand dark sedan.

instruction: Pass the partially visible blue truck on the right, then stop behind the white taxi ahead on the left.
paraphrases: Go past the blue truck on the right and stop behind the white taxi.|After the partly visible blue truck, pull over behind the white taxi on the left.
